scenarios.decision: Save charges for the dry months; refill bushes with rain once they are stripped during the drought.
Save charges for the pack; cull two days after it arrives (it has spread out by then), before it eats the warren out.
Go into winter with fewer foxes: cull on the warning if there are 12 or more; rain once bushes are stripped in the cold.
